topic_title: Driving is a Privilege — Risk, Responsibilities & Consequences
prompt: If a driver is involved in a motor vehicle collision resulting in injury or death in Texas, what is their immediate legal obligation under TTC §550.021?

options.text: Drive immediately to the nearest police station before reporting any crash details
Wait inside the vehicle until insurance adjusters arrive to photograph the crash
Immediately stop at the scene, render assistance, and provide required identification
Exchange phone numbers with other drivers and leave without notifying police
